pages.text: $(italic)"A small piece of Dr. Kacper Darlin"$()$(br2)This one's carrier is matter: the crystal itself belongs to Dr. Darlin's body.$(br2)Of the seven fragments, this is the only one recovered from a defocus product.
pages.title: Fragment: Copper Sulfate Crystal

pages.text: $(bold)Event:$() at some moment, a researcher became copper sulfate.$(br2)$(bold)Collection:$() a copper block defocuses; it drops with a chance when broken.
